summary: Confirmed PARTIAL. PR #710 (60633eff3) did proposal parts 1, 2, 3 and 4 for Codex and Claude, which cover the default selection and the measured case. Titles, branch names and summaries now run lightweight in an isolated tmp cwd: Codex with --ignore-user-config and friends; Claude with --setting-sources '', strict empty MCP, a short system prompt, --tools '' and --no-session-persistence. Each falls back once to the full config on a non-timeout error, with a 30 s timeout. The reactor asks for title and branch in one call (includeBranch) and starts generation only after the first assistant delta, or after the turn starts plus 1 s (15 s cap). Retry dropped from 2 to 1. Claude sendTurn awaits CLI init, so the deferral really does land after the boot. Tests cover the flags, the isolated cwd, the fallback and the merged call. The only open part is the optional sub-item "same for OpenCode/Cursor/Grok/Copilot": none of those got lightweight/isolated naming or a 30 s naming timeout. Copilot also ignores includeBranch, so worktree mode still makes two calls there. OpenCode has no timeout at all.

evidence.note: generateFirstTurnTitleAndBranch: waits on input.underway (1560). generateThreadTitle has includeBranch when a worktree branch is wanted (1576-1579), retry {times:1, exponential 2s} (1581). titled.branch is reused (1605). The separate generateBranchName runs only when the title is skipped, fails or has no branch (1606).

awaitFirstTurnUnderway returns on the first assistant thread.message-sent (decider maps assistant.delta to message-sent with streaming:true, decider.ts:2880-2903), or on turnStarted plus firstTurnGenerationDelayMs (default 1 s, line 242). Capped at 15 s (245).
Subscription opened before the fork and closed when underway settles. turnStarted is settled via Effect.ensuring after providerService.sendTurn.
sendTurnOnContext awaits awaitCliInitialized before turn.started, so the deferred generation really starts after the Claude CLI boot.

CODEX_NAMING_TIMEOUT_MS = 30 s, CODEX_LIGHTWEIGHT_ARGS, runCodexNamingJson (isolated cwd, lightweight, then withFullConfigFallback). Used by generateBranchName (461), generateThreadTitle (488) and summarizeWorkspaceChanges.

CLAUDE_NAMING_TIMEOUT_MS = 30 s. Lightweight settings: disableAllHooks, autoMemoryEnabled false, claudeMdExcludes. Lightweight args: --setting-sources '', --strict-mcp-config, empty --mcp-config, --system-prompt. runClaudeNamingJson forces toolsEnabled:false and persistSession:false in both the lightweight and the full attempt. The auditor's 132-153 range is slightly off.

LightweightTextGenerationOperation covers title, branch and summary. isolatedTextGenerationDirectory and withFullConfigFallback (a timeout is final) cover the verifier's caveat about custom providers and apiKeyHelper.
Tests cover Codex and Claude naming: lightweight first, isolated cwd, full-config fallback in the project cwd, and for Claude --tools '' plus --no-session-persistence in both attempts.
Cursor title and branch use the full ACP runtime in the project cwd with CURSOR_TIMEOUT_MS 180 s. Only the summary uses 30 s. includeBranch is honoured.
Same as Cursor: GROK_TIMEOUT_MS 180 s for title and branch, the project cwd and the full config.

The Copilot title uses clientFactory(input.cwd) with the full env, COPILOT_THREAD_TITLE_TIMEOUT_MS = 60 s, no config isolation (unlike answerSideQuestion at 137-215, which sets configDirectory, enableConfigDiscovery:false and so on), and no abort signal. It ignores includeBranch (title-only schema), so worktree mode still makes Copilot title + Codex-fallback branch = 2 calls. The branch goes to the lightweight Codex fallback (282-283).

OpenCode title and branch have no isolation and no timeout at all. tryPromise ignores the signal, so a hung server pins the call and the serverOwner scope. The repo itself says OpenCode cannot isolate server plugins (431-433), so only a timeout is feasible there.
The other generateBranchName callers go through the same provider method, so for Codex and Claude they also get the lightweight 30 s path. No uncovered Codex/Claude caller.

remaining: Only the optional last sub-item of proposal part 1 remains. (a) Cursor title/branch (CursorTextGeneration.ts:247-285) and Grok title/branch (GrokTextGeneration.ts:243-280) still run the full ACP runtime in the project cwd with the 180 s timeouts at CursorTextGeneration.ts:35 and GrokTextGeneration.ts:41. (b) The Copilot title (CopilotTextGeneration.ts:73-125) uses the full config/env in the project cwd with a 60 s timeout and no abort signal. It also ignores includeBranch, so Copilot worktree threads still need a second (Codex) call for the branch. (c) OpenCode title/branch (OpenCodeTextGeneration.ts:355-398 via runOpenCodeJson 108-300) has no timeout and is not interruptible. Isolation is not feasible there per 431-433. All of this is low priority: none of these is the default text-generation selection, and the measurements covered only Codex and Claude.
fixDefects: No functional bug found in the Codex/Claude fix. Minor notes: (1) Worst case is larger than the auditor said. In worktree mode a title that fails both attempts (each up to 30 s lightweight + 30 s full, plus the 2 s backoff) is followed by a separate generateBranchName (another 30+30 s), about 3 min total, still well under the old ~9 min. (2) Users whose lightweight call always fails with a non-timeout error (custom model_provider in config.toml, apiKeyHelper in settings.json, or an older CLI without the flags) pay one wasted lightweight spawn per title and then the heavy full-config spawn. That is no gain for them. A per-instance sticky fallback would fix it. (3) Plausible caveat, not verified at runtime: routing set only in ~/.codex/config.toml or the ~/.claude/settings.json env (not in the Ryco provider-instance env, which is preserved) is ignored by the lightweight call. If default credentials also exist, the call can succeed against the default endpoint or account rather than fail over. This is the same trade-off already accepted for side questions.
implementationSketch: 1) Cursor/Grok: rename CURSOR_SUMMARY_TIMEOUT_MS and GROK_SUMMARY_TIMEOUT_MS to *_NAMING_TIMEOUT_MS (30 s) and pass timeoutMs in generateThreadTitle and generateBranchName. Optionally wrap these in withFullConfigFallback, with the lightweight attempt running runCursorJson/runGrokJson with cwd from isolatedTextGenerationDirectory(operation) (keeps project rules and .cursor/mcp.json out) and the full attempt using input.cwd. 2) Copilot: extract the isolated session config from answerSideQuestion (CopilotTextGeneration.ts:137-215: clientFactory(cwd, true), configDirectory = isolated dir, enableConfigDiscovery/OnDemandInstructionDiscovery/FileHooks/Skills/SessionStore false, systemMessage replace with lightweightSystemPrompt(operation), infiniteSessions off) into a shared helper. Use it for generateThreadTitle with withFullConfigFallback, lower COPILOT_THREAD_TITLE_TIMEOUT_MS to 30 s and honour the tryPromise abort signal (session.abort). Also use buildThreadTitlePrompt's outputSchema with includeBranch/branchChangeTypes and sanitizeThreadTitleResult so worktree threads need one call. 3) OpenCode: wrap runOpenCodeJson for title, branch and summary in Effect.timeoutOption(30 s) and pass the signal to the SDK call, or abort the session on interrupt, so a hung server does not pin serverOwner. Isolation stays out of scope (see 431-433). 4) Optional for Codex/Claude: remember per text-generation instance when the lightweight attempt failed with a non-timeout error, and go straight to full for later calls (reset on settings change). 5) Tests: extend SideQuestionProviders.test.ts with Cursor, Grok and Copilot naming cases (isolated cwd, fallback). Add hanging-fake timeout tests in CursorTextGeneration.test.ts, GrokTextGeneration.test.ts, OpenCodeTextGeneration.test.ts and CopilotTextGeneration.test.ts. Add a Copilot includeBranch test asserting a single call returns {title, branch}. Run focused vitest for apps/server textGeneration only.
decisionReason: Applies the isolation/fallback pattern already approved for Codex and Claude to non-default providers; no auth/E2EE/Hub/hosted-lifecycle change. Making OpenCode titles time out is a plain reliability bound.
